newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian telephone charges to be cut from Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: Italian telephone charges to be cut from Oct 1.

text.p: Reductions in Italian telephone charges, announced earlier this year, will be introduced from October 1, under-secretary at the Post ministry, Michele Lauria, told Reuters on Friday.
The government has estimated that the overhaul in telephone tariffs will help cut inflation by just 0.01 percentage points.
The changes will include a 4.6 percent reduction in international charges and an 18 percent reduction in the price of long distance domestic phone calls.

The post ministry has estimated that the revision will cost Telecom Italia 700 billion lire a year in lower revenues. However the state controlled telecoms operator has said this loss should be covered by an anticipated increase in telephone calls. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
